topic: Dashboard data visibility and performance issues
summary_markdown: The discussion covered multiple technical issues regarding dashboard data visibility and system performance. First, an urgent request was raised concerning South Africa users who could not view golf data in the dashboard. It was suggested that the client might require a different type of visualization (e.g., 'Mall' tab) or specific screenshots from the 'golf numbers'. Separately, it was noted that analytics performance was slow due to many new Brazilian virtual sensors. A fix for this slowdown was released to production.
decisions: A fix was deployed to production addressing slow analytics performance caused by new Brazilian virtual sensors.
action_items: Investigate and resolve the issue preventing South Africa users from viewing golf data in the dashboard.
Provide screenshots of 'golf numbers' when logged in as provantage.
